programme.title: Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald
programme.desc: A few months after his arrest, Gellert Grindelwald manages to escape while being escorted to the Old Continent.Soon he begins to gather allies.His goal is to establish the domination of wizards over muggles throughout the world.He easily manages to convince his brethren to fight against humans.Professor Albus Dumbledore asks his former student Newt Scamander for help.So the magizoologist sets out to find Credence Barebone, who has hidden in Paris.Grindelwald is also heading there, intending to convince the boy to join him.They are followed by Tina, who is in love with a lover of unusual animals without reciprocity.Once again, Jacob Kowalski will be involved in a magical intrigue, and with him his beloved, slightly eccentric sorceress Queenie.However, the Muggle's careless behavior will put their relationship to the test.The secret hidden by the Lestrange family will also be revealed.

programme.title: The Angry Birds Movie
programme.desc: A flock of colorful flightless birds lives on a quiet, exotic island.In this paradise community, there is no shortage of outsiders, such as the hot-tempered Red, the quick-as-the-wind Chuck, and the explosive Bomb.Unexpectedly, their happiness is interrupted by the appearance of mysterious green pigs.The picture impresses with its refined animation.Full of humor and positive energy, the production, whose plot refers to the popular smartphone game "Angry Birds", will appeal to both younger and older viewers.The film was directed by two debutants: Clay Kaytis and Fergal Reilly;and in the Polish version you can hear the voices of, among others:Jacek Bończyk, Janusz Zadura, Piotr Bąk and Marta Dobecka.

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Small-time marijuana dealer David Clark tries to help teenagers living in his neighborhood.He is attacked by three homeless punks and robbed of his goods and cash.As a result, he becomes indebted to his supplier, Brad Gurdlinger.To repay the debt, he must import the latest batch of stimulants from Mexico.To conceal himself, he arranges helpers to pretend to be his immediate family going on vacation with him.So David's neighbors go on the road with him: cynical stripper Rose O'Reilly, the drug dealer's would-be client, the dim-witted Kenny Rossmore, and the smart, street-savvy teenager Casey Mathis.A laugh-out-loud action movie full of well-acted episodes and indecent gags.This is another joint project of Jason Sudeikis and Jennifer Aniston, after the comedies "Get Your Ex" and "Horrible Bosses".

programme.title: Silent Trees
programme.desc: Runa, a sixteen-year-old Kurdish girl, flees Iraq with her family from ISIS attacks.Over time, he reaches the Polish-Belarusian border and then to Poland, where he and his relatives receive asylum.Unfortunately, the price the family pays for getting to Europe is high.Runa's mother, being in an advanced stage of pregnancy, dies in the hospital due to exhaustion caused by her stay in the border forest.Now Runa has to grow up at an accelerated pace - she becomes the head of the family, because she has to take care of not only her four younger brothers, but also her father, who cannot cope with the growing difficulties.

programme.title: U.S. Against The World: Four Years With The Men National Soccer Team
programme.desc: The story of the US men's national soccer team on its way to the 2026 FIFA World Cup in North America. The film shows Christian Pulisic, Tyler Adams, Tim Weah and Weston McKennie personally and professionally.

programme.title: Broke
programme.desc: Former rodeo champion True cannot accept the end of his career.He is surprised by a violent blizzard.He fights for survival.

programme.title: Elysium
programme.desc: The year is 2154. Los Angeles resembles a landfill.People are struggling to survive on a devastated Earth, full of violence and poverty.Rich people live on the Elysium space station.Among the technologies available to them are medical capsules that cure diseases.One day, Max Da Costa, who lives in the slums, is heavily irradiated as a result of an accident at a factory.The dose is lethal.He has five days left.He realizes that only the capsule can save him.So he visits the smuggler Spider, hoping that thanks to him he will get to Elysium.The man promises help on the condition that he will kidnap the wealthy Carlyle for him.The dying Da Costa's body is enhanced with new technology.He soon comes into possession of secret information that could destroy the current order.

programme.title: Joe Baby
programme.desc: A debt collector is to recover USD 10 million for a real estate entrepreneur.He becomes entangled in the world of crime and corruption.

programme.title: A Carpenter Christmas Romance
programme.desc: Writer Andrea returns to her family farm in Wildwood just before the holidays.She begins an affair with her ex-boyfriend Seth, who was employed in the crew renovating the town after the recent fire.

programme.title: The Housewives of the North Pole
programme.desc: Friends Trish and Diana (Betsy Brandt) win the competition for the best Christmas home decoration every year.When they break off the relationship after a quarrel, they take part in the struggle as rivals.

programme.title: Upon Entry
programme.desc: Venezuelan Diego (Alberto Ammann) and Spanish Elena (Bruna Cusí) decide to move to the United States.The couple successfully passed the visa procedure and packed all their belongings.It seems that nothing will stop them from building a new life in the USA soon.At the immigration area at the New York airport, they are asked to talk.Inside the cramped interior, Diego and Elena are subjected to a thorough inspection by border officers.Routine activities turn into a grueling interrogation that lasts several hours.Secrets that they never shared with each other are revealed.

programme.title: Green Book
programme.desc: USA, 1960s. Tony Vallelonga, a simple resident of the Bronx who has a wife and a group of children to support, agrees to accompany, as a chauffeur and bodyguard, a black musician - the luxurious erudite Donald Shirley - on a concert tour across the United States.Not only does he have to defend his protégé from troubles in the Deep South, but he also has to combat prejudiced views.During their journey, they both follow the instructions from the "Green Book" guide for African Americans traveling around the country.It includes, among others:suggestions on where to sleep and eat to avoid unpleasant incidents.The time spent together and overcoming mounting problems cause a surprising, lasting bond to emerge between men from different worlds.

programme.title: Silver Star
programme.desc: African American Billie (Troy Leigh-Anne Johnson) is twenty years old and a tomboy.He comes from a military family and is missing one eye.After serving her prison sentence, she discovers that her separated parents are facing eviction.He decides to prevent this at all costs.The woman decides to rob a bank, but the action ends in failure.As a result, the young criminal takes her client hostage.Pregnant Franny (Grace Van Dien) is eighteen years old and has a head open to crazy ideas.Together they escape and set off on an adventurous journey.At one point, Franny offers Billie an unexpected deal.

programme.title: The Idea of You
programme.desc: Solene (Anne Hathaway) is the owner of an art gallery.One day, a divorced woman accompanies her daughter to a concert and meets her musical idol - the singer of the boy band Hayes Campbell (Nicholas Galitzine), about whom teenagers fantasize.Despite the significant age difference, they both feel that they have a lot in common.They start an affair.Paparazzi make their romantic moments miserable.The revelation of a young musician's relationship with a middle-aged single mother turns out to be a media sensation.An unusual love story with a script based on the novel by Robinne Lee.

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: Eddie Brock (Tom Hardy) is an ambitious investigative journalist who, thanks to his determination, always achieves his goal.However, when one of his missions - exposing the unethical activities of the Life Foundation - turns into an obsession, Eddie loses his job and breaks up with his fiancée Anne (Michelle Williams).Weakened, he accidentally enters into a symbiosis with an alien - the fruit of the experiments of the company owner, the sinister millionaire Calton Drake (Riz Ahmed).The journalist and the alien together create a powerful and bloodthirsty monster.Eddie must find a way out of the situation before a dangerous monster takes him completely over.Meanwhile, Drake follows the reporter's trail and wants to get his property back.The comic Venom was created years ago by David Michelinie and Todd McFarlane.

credits.actor: Security Chief Roland Treece - Scott Haze

programme.title: The Royal Hotel
programme.desc: Two American friends, Hanna (Julia Garner) and Liv (Jessica Henwick), decide to travel around Australia this summer.Unfortunately, at some point they run out of money.Women need to find temporary work.Their choice falls on a provincial mining settlement, where there is the only local bar called "The Royal Hotel".They quickly manage to adapt to the unusual atmosphere of this place, although this requires developing a specific strategy.Soon they are faced with a situation over which they lose control.

programme.title: Lord Of The Flies
programme.desc: A film adaptation of William Golding's 1954 novel.A group of British boys on a desert island try to create fair rules.However, fear and power struggles lead to chaos and aggression.

programme.title: 4 from there
programme.desc: Another installment of the adventures of people living in a town straight from a nightmare.It is a terrifying place that traps anyone who crosses its borders.Desperate residents fight to stay alive.

programme.title: Closer
programme.desc: London.Stripper and waitress Alice (Natalie Portman) has a minor accident on the street.Writer Dan (Jude Law) takes her to the hospital.They fall in love with each other almost at first sight and move in together.A few months later, Dan falls in love with talented photographer Anna (Julia Roberts).Although she is not indifferent to the writer, knowing about his relationship with Alice, she does not want to meet him.To take revenge, Dan impersonates her in one of the erotic chat rooms and starts a spicy conversation with doctor Larry (Clive Owen).The first real meeting between Larry and Anna is quite unfortunate, but soon they both fall in love and get married.After some time, the woman meets Dan again and the old fascination is revived.Meanwhile, Larry meets Alice and falls under her spell.Adapted from a play by Patrick Marber.Clive Owen and Natalie Portman received Golden Globe and Oscar nominations.

programme.title: Den sidste viking
programme.desc: After fourteen years of imprisonment, Anker (Nikolaj Lie Kaas) is released from prison and has only one goal: to recover the loot from the last robbery.The problem is that the fortune was hidden by his brother Manfred (Mads Mikkelsen), who today introduces himself as John Lennon and suffers from a mental illness.His older sister Freja (Bodil Jorgensen) takes care of him.For the impulsive Anker, his relative's fragile psyche is a minefield and the only way to get his money back.Looking for the key to unlocking his brother's memories, the man starts cooperation with Lothar (Lars Brygmann), whom he met in the hospital, who proposes an unusual experiment to him.With the help of a team of strange characters, they reactivate the legendary band The Beatles... A full of absurdities, a reckless ride through the past, fractured psyche, brotherly loyalty and a world where logic no longer applies.Oscar-winning director Anders Thomas Jensen proves once again that, together with Mads Mikkelsen, he creates cult films.

programme.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: The situation of the mutant monkeys changes with the appearance of a formation led by the Colonel, which seeks to take control of the apes.Meanwhile, Blue Eyes informs his father that he has found a place for their tribe to live.The decision is made to march.Under the cover of darkness, an attack occurs.Caesar's son and wife are killed.Despite the tragedy, the primate leader believes in the success of a peaceful solution.On his own, he searches for the person responsible for the massacre, but falls into the hands of the enemy.He then finds out that his compatriots were forced to work as slaves.People are attacked by a virus that reverses the process of evolution.The final showdown is inevitably approaching.

programme.title: Robin Williams: Come Inside My Mind
programme.desc: The film presents the career and extraordinary life of Robin Williams described mainly in his words.Never-before-published materials were used in the making of the documentary.The film also includes interviews with the actor's closest people, who outline his work style.Featuring: Billy Crystal, Eric Idle, Whoopie Goldberg, David Letterman, Steve Martin, Pam Dawber and Robin's son - Zakie.The film is directed by two-time Emmy Award winner Marina Zenovich (Roman Polański. Fugitive and Desired).

programme.title: Soul On Fire
programme.desc: Nine-year-old John O'Leary suffers burns to almost his entire body.He struggles with pain and limitations.However, he wins love and makes his dreams come true.He inspires others by showing how to live life to the fullest.

programme.title: Peasants
programme.desc: In Lipce, life goes according to the rhythm of nature.Maciej Boryna, the richest man in the village, decides to take Jagna as his wife.Although the girl prefers colorful clothes and paper cutouts to working in the fields, and there are numerous rumors about her reputation, she cannot resist the temptation.He strikes a deal with Dominikowa, who agrees to marry his daughter to him.Soon there is a grand wedding.However, the bride is not happy.He loves his stepson, Antek, with reciprocity, which quickly becomes clear to his wife Hanka.Boryna's son is not only constantly looking for an opportunity to meet his stepmother, but also, taking pride in his honor, condemns the family to vegetation.Subsequent dramatic events cause the entire community's resentment against Jagna to turn into open hostility.

programme.title: Welcome to Marwen
programme.desc: Mark Hogancamp (Steve Carell) is an illustrator, known primarily for his World War II graphics.However, he hides quite an original preference.He is fascinated by women's shoes.At home, she has a large collection of high heels, sandals, flip-flops and many other shoes.His secret is revealed unexpectedly and causes great emotions.He is attacked by a group of neo-Nazis.The injuries are so severe that they result in loss of not only memory, but also the ability to speak and move.His artistic career is ruined.The man starts therapy, hoping to regain his former shape.However, he struggles with enormous trauma and mental problems.He finally manages to find a new passion.He constructs a village in the garden, which he names Marwen.Its inhabitants, the dolls, are modeled on real people from his life.It turns out that the mockup helps him deal with panic attacks.However, he still cannot forget his experiences.Meanwhile, a new neighbor, Nicol (Leslie Mann), moves in next door.The film is inspired by the true story of artist Mark Hogancamp.The town he built is located in Kingston.

programme.title: Bastille Day
programme.desc: On the eve of Bastille Day, an American thief living in Paris, Michael Mason (Richard Madden), steals a bag containing a teddy bear.Not knowing that there is a bomb hidden inside the toy, he takes the money and documents and throws the rest into a trash bin in a crowded Paris metro station.A few seconds later there is a huge explosion.Four people die.City surveillance footage reveals Michael's face.The police, considering him a terrorist, start searching for him.He is stopped by CIA agent Sean Briar (Idris Elba), who is just trying to find his way back to work after returning from Iraq.He brings the suspect to a secret interrogation room.Michael explains the misunderstanding and convinces that someone else is behind the attack.He and Sean have 24 hours to find the real culprits.The film was shot in 2015 and became even more relevant after the attacks in Paris.
